rationale: Assess three selected sealed manuscripts using sixteen fresh source-grounded simulations of the announced judges.
effective_from: first round binding this exact version
comparability: Qualitative within-panel assessment; no validated prediction of actual contest votes or controlled model comparison.
independent_critique: Sixteen separate actual sessions review identical anonymous manuscript bytes in rotated order. After every review is sealed, a critic may synthesize the panel without altering prior reviews.
budget: One assessment of three finalists from the authorized twenty-essay series; no publication, submission, API spending or further manuscript campaign.
